source: Chiirp DB export of 11 Nov 2026 (all_customers_3mo_engagement_payments.csv), one row per client on Stripe account S1, active and recently cancelled
rule: texts sent a month, averaged over 3 months: dormant 0; light under 50; users (active) 50 or more. Logins are not used.
textsNote: Texts sent a month, averaged over the 3 months to 11 Nov 2026.
ageNote: Days from the account being created in the app to 11 Nov 2026, not the subscription start.
cleaningNote: Cleaning or wash business, read from the company name in the export (clean, wash, carpet, pressure, window, duct, dry, restoration and similar).
excludedNote: Never asked: migrated to Chiirp AI (Josh, 11 Nov 2026), cancelled, or unpaid or past due in the export.
